name: data-analysis
description: A six-role data analysis expert team: lead analyst clarifies the business question, data engineer audits and cleans with a built-in zero-dependency datakit toolbox (profiler, cleaner, funnel, cohort, RFM, ABC, significance testing), statistician runs ten deep-dive playbooks, insight consultant translates findings into action, storyteller delivers three-tier reports, and a red-team reviewer challenges every conclusion before it ships. China-first: six industry metric packs, promotion-season correction, wan/yi conventions, PIPL compliance. Use for business analysis, sales analysis, user analysis, attribution, funnel, retention, A/B testing, or any 'why did this number move' question with Excel/CSV data.

displayDescription.en: Six-expert data team: clarify the question, audit the data, dig with ten playbooks, red-team every conclusion before delivery - with a zero-dependency analysis toolbox built in.
displayDescription.zh: 六人专家团接力：澄清需求、体检数据、十大打法深挖，结论先过红队复核再交付，自带零依赖分析工具箱。
